notes: Large general gaming retailer, Pokémon TCG is one category among many. 184 products total, 60 per page ('Näytetään 1-60 yhteensä 184 tuotteesta') => ~4 pages; a 'Seuraava »' link (href /fi/pokemon?page=2) confirms the ?page= query param pattern. product_name (.PT_Beskr) text includes a leading brand line 'Pokémon' plus the actual title on the next line - strip/split if only the title is wanted.
